# v1.20.0 - Design Intelligence Blended Into the System, and Humane UX
## Projects 24 v1.20.0: Design Intelligence Blended Into the System, and Humane UX

A searchable design database joins the specification without overriding it, and every UI task now carries a humane-UX check.

### Key Highlights
- **Skill `ui-ux-pro-max`** (adapted from nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill, MIT): 79 styles, 192 palettes, 74 font pairings, 119 UX guidelines, 25 chart types, 22 stacks; offline Python search; 138 tests on Python 3.9 and 3.14.
- **Rule 21 (`21-design-intelligence.md`)**: order of authority (research and brand first), tokens instead of raw values, measured contrast, recorded licences, no borrowed statistics, and sourced components (21st.dev, shadcn registries, generators) treated as third-party code.
- **Rule 09 section 9, "Make it humane"**: plain language, feedback, forgiveness, helpful errors, calm tone, respect for attention and inclusion, grounded in Nielsen's heuristics and the COGA guidance.
- **Blended in**: nine existing skills and rules gained short additions that point to the new material; critique gained a "Humane quality" pass.
- **MCP catalog**: vetting notes for the 21st.dev Magic server.

### Verification
- Local checks before release: `npm run verify`, the skill's Python tests, actionlint, hidden-Unicode scan, secret audit of the new data.
- CI results for this tag: see the Validate workflow run in the Actions tab.

**Full changelog**: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/gerrardgs/Projects24/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
